summary: Practise coding, comparing cases, and reporting qualitative findings with NVivo. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: NVivo training helps qualitative researchers, monitoring and evaluation staff, and analysts turn coded interviews, survey responses, and documents into traceable findings. You’ll practise preparing sources, building and refining a codebook, coding consistently, comparing cases with matrix queries, and creating charts or project maps linked to source extracts for reports and evidence briefs; advanced query and visualization options are introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level NVivo course is designed for professionals who handle qualitative material and need to show how their findings connect to source evidence. It suits people preparing research summaries, evaluation reports, service reviews, and evidence briefs.
prerequisites: Basic computer skills are expected. Prior NVivo experience and programming skills are not required; familiarity with interview, focus group, or document-based research is helpful.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
